```yaml
name: Test Meshery Integration
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**/*'
      - '*.md'
  push:
    branches:
      - '*'
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**/*'
      - '*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Sistent dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build Sistent
        run: npm run build

      - name: Pack Sistent as tarball
        id: pack
        run: |
          npm pack
          TARFILE=$(ls *.tgz)
          echo "tarball=$TARFILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery-ui
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: npm install

      - name: Install Sistent tarball into Meshery UI
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: npm install ../${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }}

      - name: Verify test script exists
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: |
          if ! grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json; then
            echo "No test script found in Meshery UI package.json"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run Meshery UI build and tests
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: |
          npm run build
          npm test

      - name: Report Results
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ ${{ job.status }} == 'success' ]; then
            echo "✅ Meshery UI integration test passed"
          else
            echo "❌ Meshery UI integration test failed"
            exit 1
          fi
```
